# Security policy

## Supported scope

Security fixes are considered for the maintained `gardener_01` example and repository automation on the default branch. The other Flutter examples are currently marked legacy and should not be treated as supported production applications.

## Report a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/okok147/Flutter-UI-Reality/security/advisories/new) to report a suspected vulnerability. Include:

- affected files and revision;
- reproduction steps or a minimal proof of concept;
- likely impact and affected users;
- any suggested mitigation;
- whether the report has been disclosed elsewhere.

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability and do not include real user secrets or unrelated personal data. Normal crashes, visual defects, dependency migrations, and compatibility problems without a security impact belong in the public bug-report form.

The maintainer will assess reports and coordinate a fix or disclosure where warranted. The project does not promise a response time, bounty, embargo duration, or acceptance of every report.
